# MSTV Network

> Free live streaming platform for Indian, Punjabi, and religious TV channels in HD. Aggregates publicly available live streams across entertainment, news, sports, cricket, and devotional categories.

MSTV Network is a free-to-watch live TV aggregator. It does not host or store any media — all streams are sourced from publicly available third-party broadcasts and embedded for viewing. The site offers 100+ live channels across categories including Entertainment, News, Sports, Cricket, Punjabi, Religious, Devotional, Kids, Movies, Music, and Comedy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://crickethd.pages.dev/): Browse and watch all live channels. Search by name or filter by category. Selecting a channel loads its live stream directly in the page.

## Notes for AI agents

- Channels are loaded dynamically from a JSON feed and may change at any time; channel availability is not guaranteed.
- Individual channels can be deep-linked via `?ch=channel-slug-name` query parameter on the home page.
- MSTV does not host, upload, or store any media files on its own servers; all content is sourced from third-party publicly accessible streams. MSTV assumes no responsibility for the availability, accuracy, or legality of linked content.
